name: Card fan pick
oneLiner: 3 to 6 glass stat cards (the brand's screens as thumbnails, metric rows) drop one by one onto a dark desk in 3D, each landing with a skid and a contact shadow; then one card is picked up off the desk, turns to face the viewer and lifts out lit in the accent with a label pill while the rest fall back
say: when the speaker lays options side by side and picks one ("lay them all out and one is obvious", "I tested five of these and kept this one"): cut in on the first option; the pick lifts on the word that names the winner. tone green when it is the proven winner
